mapper.select: SELECT om.model, om.BUILD, ge.PRODUCT_TYPE, ge.VIN, om.SYMBOL_STR, ge.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION, om.CUSTOMER_ADAP, ants.FAMILY_ID, ants.VARIANT_ID FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_OM om LEFT JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL ge ON om.SERIE = ge.SERIE AND om.CHNR = ge.CHNR LEFT JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_VARIANTS ants ON ants.SERIE = ge.SERIE AND ants.CHNR = ge.CHNR WHERE om.SERIE = #{serie} AND om.CHNR = #{chno}
SELECT SYMBOL, DESCRIPTION FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_VARIANT WHERE FAMILY_ID = #{familyId} AND VARIANT_ID = #{variantId}
